segments.oily: One reviewer describes very oily, tolerant skin that handled the 0.10% well with only minor dryness and peeling around the brows and nasal creases.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report needing to double up on moisturizer, using the sandwich method, or occasional flaking, though several say the product did not dry out their skin at all.
segments.combination: Two reviewers with combination skin report a pleasant texture and no irritation after about two and a half weeks, without yet being able to confirm longer-term results.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: several report zero irritation, tolerable use, and improved texture, while one reports her 0.10% use caused severe flaking, scaliness and redness around the nose, chin and forehead that persisted after stopping.
segments.normal: A reviewer with normal-to-dry sensitive skin reports fading acne marks and softer, smoother skin after about a month, with only slight dryness managed by moisturizer; another with normal skin in a warm climate reports no dryness and faded dark spots after several tubes.
segments.mature: Mature-skin reviewers (40s to 70s) report mixed results: some describe smoother, brighter, firmer skin and reduced fine lines, while one in her early 70s reports no visible improvement after a year of use.

concerns.aging: Many reviewers report reduced fine lines, smoother texture, firmer skin, and a brighter, plumper look, some within weeks; dissent includes one long-term user with few wrinkles who saw no improvement, and one who felt wrinkles became more pronounced and skin duller after switching to 0.10%.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers report the serum does not dry out skin and is more hydrating than retinol or tretinoin; several dissent, noting dryness, flakiness, or the need to double-moisturize, especially when increasing to 0.10% too quickly.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers specifically report no redness despite daily use; one reviewer with dry/sensitive skin reports ongoing redness and flakiness around the nose and forehead after use.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers switching from tretinoin or retinol frequently report better tolerance and less irritation with this serum, describing it as gentler on the skin barrier; one reviewer nonetheless reports her barrier reacted badly with scaling and flaking that persisted after stopping.
concerns.spots: Multiple reviewers report fading dark spots, hyperpigmentation, or acne marks over weeks to months of consistent use; no reviewer reports spots worsening.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers with acne-prone or blemish-prone skin report clearer skin, faster healing of breakouts, and fading blemishes; one reviewer reports the serum made her break out constantly even after months of use, and another noted increased breakouts more recently despite past success.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer with very oily skin reports good tolerance and effectiveness at 0.10%, with no complaints of increased oiliness from any reviewer.

extraits.titre: .10% is not for those with dry/sensitive skin!
extraits.texte: I bought this serum after slowly increasing my retinal %, starting with .01 (from another brand) then switched to Naturium .05%, and my skin did well with both. I use the "sandwich" method because I have dry skin in the winter, and I double moisturize on top. Hoping to see more substantial results, I started using the .10%. I kept following the same methods, and using every other day/every 3 days as I was with the lower %. Now my skin is SO flaky and scaly around my nose, chin, upper lip, and forehead. I stopped using it a week ago and have been using moisturizing serums and creams and I am still so flaky/scaly/red. I would not recommend increasing to the .10% if you have dry and sensitive skin. Unfortunately now I have a whole tube of this serum that I am afraid to use.

extraits.titre: The only product that has made a difference.
extraits.texte: I have normal to dry sensitive skin. I get the occasional breakout that always leaves super dark scars that never seem to fade no matter what I would use. Over time these marks add up, and I tried every chemical exfoliant under the sun and nothing would lighten them up. I've always been afraid of trying any type of retinol because I have sensitive skin and not to mention the dreaded purge that everyone talks about.i saw that this serum is supposed to be more gentle yet effective so i decided to give it a shot. I started off with the stronger one using it just one night a week working my way up to almost every night now. It's been a little over a month and my skin is the softest and smoothest it's ever been, and my acne marks are all almost gone! Luckily I never had a purging phase. My skin does get slightly dry when I use it, but my moisturizer takes care of that. I'm so happy that I decided to try this. I can't wait to see how my skin continues to improve.

I was on my third tube of the .05 Retinaldehyde serum and used it every night for many months. I definitely saw improvements in the finest lines and in overall texture as well. When the .10 was announced, I ordered it that day. I can tell the difference in product strength! I am actually instinctively in a skin cycling program now. I had a tiny bit of dryness and the slightest peeling around my brows and nasal creases. So, I know the .10 is a more powerful product. I am really happy about it and look forward to even more improvements in the coming months. As info, I am using the .10 3-4 nights per week. Also, I have very oily, tolerant skin. So, I suspect that if your skin is dry or sensitive, you may wish to incorporate this new serum at a slow and measured pace. But I do believe it will be helpful and can be done. (Female, fair skin, 40yrs old).

Love this. I used the lower percentage a few months ago and was able to tolerate so I bumped up to this percentage. I have sensitive skin so I was hesitant. I've only been using it a few weeks but I can tell it's working. I'm starting slowly by using it only twice a week. Maybe in another week I'll bump it up to 3 days a week. For me It can be drying but I just double up my moisturizer. And my face is always glowing after I use it.
I had zero issues using this on my extremely sensitive acne prone skin. Plumps your skin and minimizes fine lines. I am repurchasing for sure.
